overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong professional cross-platform presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a total reach of 3,580 followers. Content primarily focuses on academic research, computational methods, disinformation, tool releases (CooRnet), and academic recruitment, driving high engagement rates particularly among research and academic communities.

contentThemes.description: Posts related to research, conference presentations, and methodological approaches for analyzing online information operations.
Announcements of new software updates and releases like CooRnet v2.0.
Announcements regarding research funding awards, postdoctoral hiring, and PhD research opportunities.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn to leverage its large follower base (1,850 followers) for driving high absolute interaction numbers.
Cross-post successful interactive content (e.g., student/postdoc recruitment calls) across all networks, as these generate high amplification via reposts on Bluesky and comments on LinkedIn.
Incorporate visual assets, links to publications, or media previews to further enhance post visibility and engagement across decentralized networks.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest relative engagement rate (averaging ~6.14%), driven strongly by reposts on publication updates and research opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a focused academic niche on aoir.social, generating solid engagement for specialized tool updates like CooRnet v2.0.
platformInsights.linkedin: Represents the largest audience base (51.7% of total followers), delivering the highest volume of total interactions per post, particularly around major professional milestones like grant awards.
